import json, subprocess, sys, os, datetime
from pathlib import Path
commands=json.loads(sys.argv[1]); run=Path(sys.argv[2])
def stamp(): return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone(datetime.timedelta(hours=8))).isoformat()
def record(value):
 p=run/'JOB.json'; t=p.with_suffix('.tmp'); t.write_text(json.dumps(value,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n'); t.replace(p)
record(dict(status='starting',pid=os.getpid(),started_at=stamp(),commands=commands))
for command in commands:
 child=subprocess.Popen(command,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL)
 record(dict(status='running',pid=os.getpid(),child_pid=child.pid,operation=command[6],updated_at=stamp(),commands=commands))
 result=child.wait()
 if result:
  record(dict(status='failed',pid=os.getpid(),operation=command[6],returncode=result,updated_at=stamp(),commands=commands)); raise SystemExit(result)
record(dict(status='completed',pid=os.getpid(),updated_at=stamp(),commands=commands))
